body: Radical nonconformity: you refuse to belong on anyone else's terms. Ideals lived out through groups and friendships, with a real sense of responsibility for others in distress and a vulnerability to being used through the wish to belong. Often rooted in early family chaos you couldn't fix and were punished for naming. Sometimes the healthiest move is a fresh start in a new circle, on your own terms.
business: Owned, this is principled independence and original thinking.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes alienation; unchecked, contrarianism for its own sake.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
